decision_rules: Always start by searching 'flights' on Google
Use Google Flights to compare options
Sort results by price to find the cheapest option
Set specific round trip dates for comparison
name: Find Cheapest Flight from Austin to Lahore

procedure.intent: Open Google Chrome to start a search
Navigate to Google and enter 'flights' to find flight booking options
Open the Google Flights search page
Set departure city to Austin and destination to Lahore
Set outbound flight date to June 12
Set return flight date to July 5
Submit the search for flights from Austin to Lahore
Sort results by price to identify the cheapest available flight
Review the cheapest flight option available

verbatim_examples.question: What do you want to do?
verbatim_examples.user_answer: Hey Clicky, so I want you to go to Google. I want you to search flights. Um, open up the flights. Make sure that we have selected flights up in the top bar here. Um, and then once we are in flights, I wanna— my home destination should be Austin. I wanna go to my actual home country, Lahore, Pakistan. I wanna go on June 12th, and I want to come back on July 5th. Here we go. And then I want you to hit search. Uh, and then most importantly, I want you to sort by price. Okay.
